reply.shortGloss: to close; to shut; to turn off
reply.emotion: practical and purposeful, finishing a task
notes: Cerrar is a stem-changing verb (e > ie), so it becomes cierro, cierras, cierra in the present tense.

senses.definition: Poner algo de modo que no esté abierto.

examples.text: Por favor, cierra la puerta al salir.
examples.translation: Please close the door when you leave.
examples.emotion: firm and polite, giving a helpful reminder

senses.definition: Interrumpir el paso de agua, gas o luz.

examples.text: No olvides cerrar la llave del agua.
examples.translation: Don't forget to turn off the water faucet.
examples.emotion: cautious and practical, giving advice to save resources

senses.definition: Terminar un negocio o dejar de atender al público por el día.

examples.text: La tienda va a cerrar temprano hoy.
examples.translation: The store is going to close early today.
examples.emotion: informative and relaxed, sharing a schedule change
